# Support

## Which channel

| You want to | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| Ask how something works | [Discussions](https://github.com/gh-training-ak/contoso-learning/discussions) |
| Report a defect | [New issue](https://github.com/gh-training-ak/contoso-learning/issues/new/choose) |
| Report a vulnerability | [Private advisory](https://github.com/gh-training-ak/contoso-learning/security/advisories/new) |
| Find a runbook | [Wiki](https://github.com/gh-training-ak/contoso-learning/wiki) |
| Page someone at 3am | The on call rota in the wiki |

## Response times

Issues are triaged on Tuesday and Thursday mornings. `priority/p0` is picked up the same day.

This is a training repository. There is no production support contract behind it.
